name: Off the Record
source:
When your repetitive days of working at a record store are interrupted by the presence of a new, shy customer, you cannot help but be drawn in. And when given the chance, will you take the chance to form a relationship, or will you let him simply remain as a fleeting customer?

[From [url=https://archivist-st.itch.io/off-the-record]itch.io[/url]]
